messages.content:
In two or three sentences, explain why a household AI lab might choose to
run a large language model locally on its own hardware instead of only
using a hosted API, even though the hosted API is usually cheaper per
token.

message.content: A local model lets the lab keep sensitive prompts, personal data, and experimental ideas on-premises, avoiding third-party logging or compliance risks. It also gives full control over fine-tuning, versioning, and low-latency offline iteration, which a hosted API cannot fully provide.
